investment_options.title: Index Funds
investment_options.tagline: The market's average — which is actually extraordinary.
investment_options.logic: Invests in the top 50 companies of the country. If the country grows, you grow.
investment_options.tax_note: Gains held >1 year: 10% LTCG. Gains <1 year: 15% STCG.
features: Passively managed — automatically mirrors the Nifty 50 or Nifty 500 index
No fund manager dependency — removes human bias and reduces cost significantly
Ultra-low expense ratio (0.05%–0.2%), letting more of your money compound
Historically outperforms 80–90% of actively managed funds over 10+ years
Instant diversification — you own shares in 50–500 top companies at once
Beginner-friendly — simple structure, easy to invest via monthly SIP
High liquidity — funds can be redeemed within 1–3 business days
Rides India's long-term economic growth — as the country expands, you expand
Resilient to crashes — has recovered fully after every major market downturn
Best strategy: start a SIP and leave it untouched for 10+ years

investment_options.title: Small-Cap Funds
investment_options.tagline: High risk, high reward — for the bold.
investment_options.logic: Bets on emerging high-growth companies before they become giants.
investment_options.tax_note: Gains held >1 year: 10% LTCG. Gains <1 year: 15% STCG.
features: Invests in companies ranked below the top 250 by market capitalisation
Massive growth potential — many of today's large-caps started as small-caps
High volatility — can fall 50%+ in downturns, demands a 10-year horizon minimum
Expert fund manager crucial — active stock selection drives outperformance here
Portfolio spread across 50–80 companies reduces single-stock blow-up risk
SIP strategy is especially powerful — cost-averaging smooths extreme price swings
Can experience liquidity stress during market crashes — expect exit loads
Top funds have delivered 18–22% CAGR historically over a full market cycle
Not suitable for money you may need within the next 5–7 years
Ideal for investors in their 20s or 30s with high risk appetite and long runway

investment_options.title: Debt Funds / FDs
investment_options.tagline: Sleep well at night. Your money is safe.
investment_options.logic: Lends your money to the government and corporations. Gets steady interest in return.
investment_options.tax_note: Taxed as per your income slab (no special rate). Use for short-term parking.
features: Lends your money to the government and top-rated corporations for fixed interest
Returns are predictable and consistent — no overnight surprise swings
Bank FDs currently offer 6.5–7.25% for 1–3 year tenures
Debt mutual funds provide better post-tax efficiency for investors in high tax brackets
Liquid funds can be redeemed within 1 business day — faster than FDs
Perfect place to park your emergency fund instead of a regular savings account
Bond prices rise when RBI cuts interest rates — potential capital gain bonus
Near-zero default risk when investing in government securities or AAA-rated bonds
Taxed as per income slab, so works best for those in the 10%–20% tax bracket
Ideal portfolio anchor — balance the volatility of equity with this stable layer

investment_options.title: Sovereign Gold Bonds
investment_options.logic: Backed by the Government of India. You get gold price growth plus an extra 2.5% annually.
investment_options.tax_note: Zero capital gains tax if held till maturity (8 years). Best tax-free option.
features: Issued directly by the Reserve Bank of India — zero counterparty or default risk
Tracks physical gold price — you profit when global gold prices rise
Extra 2.5% annual interest paid directly to your bank account every 6 months
Completely tax-free capital gains if held until maturity at 8 years
No storage hassle — no physical gold, no locker fees, no security concerns
Tradeable on the stock exchange after the 5-year lock-in for early exit
Natural inflation hedge — gold tends to rise when equities fall sharply
Minimum investment of just 1 gram (~₹6,000) — highly accessible for beginners
Low correlation with stock markets — great portfolio diversifier
Best used alongside equity investments to reduce overall portfolio drawdown

investment_options.title: Blue Chip Stocks
investment_options.tagline: Own a piece of India's biggest companies.
investment_options.logic: Direct ownership in established giants. Their profit is your profit.
investment_options.what_it_invests_in: Established giants — Reliance, HDFC, TCS, Infosys
investment_options.tax_note: Gains held >1 year: 10% LTCG. Gains <1 year: 15% STCG.
features: Direct ownership in India's most established and financially stable companies
These businesses have survived multiple recessions, crashes, and global crises
Regular dividends provide passive income on top of stock price appreciation
Strong economic moats — brands like TCS and HDFC rarely face existential threats
Moderate volatility — less wild than small-caps, far more growth than FDs
Requires a SEBI-regulated demat account — fully transparent and investor-protected
Understanding business fundamentals gives you a significant edge when picking stocks
A focused portfolio of just 8–12 quality stocks can build serious long-term wealth
Dividend reinvestment compounds returns powerfully over a 10–20 year horizon
More control and transparency than mutual funds — you decide exactly what you own
